notes: "If you want to try it, open the editor and start a project, or open an existing deck. Connect the AI client you already use from Agent setup. Then do what I did for this talk: tell the agent your story first, out loud and freestyle, and let it organise the story before it makes any slides. After that, ask for one change at a time, read the preview, apply it, and look at the review. The code and the build commands are on the right, and the repository is at the bottom. Thank you."

designIntent.purpose: Give concrete first steps for users and contributors.
designIntent.requestedChange: Story-driven rework: organise the founder's reasons for building HUANDENG and show the features that answer them.
